plugins.name: Deezer (unofficial)
plugins.description: Browse and search Deezer and your library, Flow and mixes included, and stream it in FLAC (HiFi plan) or MP3, original codec unchanged, with seeking. Lyrics, radio, artist and album details, your own playlists editable. Sign in with your browser's arl cookie. Unofficial, uses Deezer's private API; needs a Deezer subscription.
plugins.author: anon7627

plugins.name: Demo Music (reference)
plugins.description: Reference implementation of the plugin protocol, for plugin authors. Serves generated test tones from your own computer; sign-in code DEMO.
plugins.author: ricercar

plugins.name: Jellyfin
plugins.description: Browse, search and play the music of your own Jellyfin server: albums, artists, playlists, favourites and folders, in ricercar's library next to your local music. Original files, bit for bit; transcode only when your DAC cannot take a file. Sign in with Quick Connect or your password.
plugins.author: ricercar-player

plugins.name: Live Music Archive
plugins.description: Hundreds of thousands of concert recordings from the Internet Archive's Live Music Archive, free to share, most of them lossless. Browse popular, recent and on-this-day shows or an artist's recordings, search, and keep favourites in your library. No account. Original FLAC files, bit for bit.
plugins.author: ricercar-player

plugins.name: Plex
plugins.description: Browse, search and play the music of your own Plex Media Server. Albums, artists and playlists merged into your library, recent albums on Home, favourites shared with Plex; plays show on the server. Original files, bit for bit; FLAC at a rate your DAC takes when it cannot play the file's.
plugins.author: ricercar-player

plugins.name: Qobuz (unofficial)
plugins.description: Browse and search your Qobuz library, and stream it at the best quality your DAC plays natively. Lyrics, radio and continuous playback, artist and album details, your own playlists editable. Qobuz Connect support: pick your player from the Qobuz app and control it from your phone. Unofficial, uses the Qobuz web API; needs a Qobuz subscription.
plugins.author: anon7627

plugins.name: SoundCloud (unofficial)
plugins.description: Search and browse SoundCloud without an account: trending and discovery shelves, artists, albums, playlists, stations and details. Plays public tracks in AAC 160 kbit/s or MP3 128 kbit/s, original codec unchanged, with seeking. Unofficial, uses SoundCloud's web API.
plugins.author: anon7627

plugins.name: Spotify (unofficial)
plugins.description: Browse and search Spotify and your library, and play it in Ogg Vorbis 320 kbit/s, original codec unchanged. Lyrics, radio, artist and album details, your own playlists editable. Spotify Connect support: pick your player from the Spotify app and control it from your phone. Unofficial, uses librespot and the Spotify Web API; needs Spotify Premium.
plugins.author: anon7627

plugins.name: Subsonic
plugins.description: Browse, search and play the music of your own Subsonic-compatible server: Navidrome, Gonic, Airsonic-Advanced, LMS, Ampache. Albums, artists, playlists and starred items, merged into your library, and Home shelves of recent, most played and random albums. Original files, bit for bit; FLAC at a rate your DAC takes when the server can transcode (Navidrome 0.64+).
plugins.author: ricercar-player

plugins.name: TIDAL (unofficial)
plugins.description: Browse and search TIDAL and your library, and stream it lossless or hi-res at the best quality your DAC plays natively, original FLAC frames unchanged. Mixes, lyrics, radio, artist and album details, your own playlists editable. Sign in with a code (CD quality) or through the TIDAL page (hi-res). Unofficial, uses the TIDAL API; needs a TIDAL subscription.
plugins.author: anon7627

plugins.name: Torznab (unofficial)
plugins.description: Search a Torznab indexer (Prowlarr, Jackett, bitmagnet…) and play music straight from BitTorrent while it downloads: releases as albums, original files bit for bit, seeking ahead, gapless preload. Covers from the torrent or Cover Art Archive, favourites in your library. You choose the indexer; use it for what you have the right to download.
plugins.author: anon7627
